use_timecounter_as_decorator: use TimeCounter as a decorator to measure and log the average running time of a function
use_timecounter_as_context_manager: use TimeCounter as a context manager with a tag to measure average execution time of a code block
use_timecounter_with_log_interval: use TimeCounter with log_interval to log average running time every N function calls
use_timecounter_with_warmup_interval: use TimeCounter with warmup_interval to exclude initial runs from the average time calculation
review_timecounter_print_time: review the TimeCounter print_time method that calculates and logs average time per run in milliseconds
